name: W Bellevue
positioning: A downtown Bellevue hotel inspired by the weekender lake house, with Lake Washington views from select rooms and direct connection to Lincoln Square South
best_for: Business travelers visiting Bellevue's corporate headquarters
Shoppers and Eastside explorers who want The Bellevue Collection on the doorstep and Seattle a short drive away

facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Bellevue, steps from local corporate headquarters and The Bellevue Collection shopping center.
Downtown Seattle, Woodinville wine country, golf courses and Pacific Northwest mountains and lakes are a short drive away.
Rooms have glass-enclosed showers with Davines bath amenities and the signature W bed.
The Lakehouse is a farmhouse-inspired restaurant serving contemporary Pacific Northwest cuisine.
The Living Room Bar & The Porch has crafted cocktails and a live DJ on Friday and Saturday nights.
The FIT fitness studio is fully equipped, with Peloton bikes.
The W Insider can arrange a personal trainer for a private HIIT, yoga or barre class.
Pets are welcome, with a W Pet Bed.

highlights.text: The hotel is inspired by the weekender lake house of yesteryear.
Select rooms and suites have views of Lake Washington.
The hotel is directly connected to Lincoln Square South and surrounded by green spaces and the beaches of Lake Washington.
The interiors blend contemporary chic with local artistry.
Civility & Unrest is a modern-day speakeasy bar with vintage spirits, local craft distillers and sparkling selections.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
WhataHotel notes the contemporary, trendy atmosphere may not suit traditional tastes.
WhataHotel notes pricing reflects the luxury brand positioning.
